plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Robusta'
plants.tip: Let the top third of the pot dry before watering. Cold, wet compost is what kills it.
plants.colour: Broad, glossy deep green leaves

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Burgundy'
plants.tip: The dark colour deepens in strong light. In a dim corner new leaves open plain green.
plants.colour: Near-black leaves with a red midrib and pink new-leaf sheath

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Abidjan'
plants.tip: Wipe the leaves monthly. Dust shows badly on dark foliage and it does slow growth.
plants.colour: Very dark burgundy-green leaves with a deep red underside

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Melany'
plants.tip: Pinch the growing tip to keep it branching, or it runs up as one bare stem.
plants.colour: Compact dark green leaves with a reddish flush beneath

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Sofia'
plants.tip: Turn the pot a quarter each week or it leans hard towards the window.
plants.colour: Small, rounded dark green leaves on a compact plant

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Tineke'
plants.tip: Needs brighter light than the plain green sort, but the cream margins scorch in midday sun.
plants.colour: Grey-green centre, irregular cream margins, pink midrib

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Ruby'
plants.tip: The pink comes from light, not feed. Too dim and new leaves open cream and green only.
plants.colour: Cream and green leaves flushed deep pink, strongest on new growth

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Belize'
plants.tip: Cut stems bleed white latex that stains and irritates skin. Wear gloves and blot the cut.
plants.colour: Green centre with cream and pink margins, pink stems

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Doescheri'
plants.tip: An all-green shoot will outgrow the variegated growth. Cut it back to a marked leaf.
plants.colour: Grey-green marbling, cream margins, pink midrib and stalks

plants.name: Ficus elastica 'Shivereana'
plants.tip: The speckling varies leaf to leaf. Bright light fixes it; more feed does not.
plants.colour: Pale green leaves speckled and blotched with cream

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Starlight'
plants.tip: Drops leaves after any move. Settle it in one bright spot and then leave it there.
plants.colour: Mostly white leaves with irregular green centres

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Danielle'
plants.tip: Sudden leaf drop means a change: a draught, a move, or cold water. Keep it all steady.
plants.colour: Dark glossy green leaves with straight, flat edges

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Golden King'
plants.tip: Loses the cream margins in poor light. Bright indirect, and never a cold draught.
plants.colour: Mid-green with broad grey-green and cream margins

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Anastasia'
plants.tip: Expect a round of leaf drop when you bring it home; it regrows once it settles.
plants.colour: Dark green centres with wavy lime-green margins

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Natasja'
plants.tip: Small pot, small plant, so it dries quickly. Check it twice a week in summer.
plants.colour: Small dark green leaves on a dwarf, dense plant

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Exotica'
plants.tip: Keep it away from doorways. Draughts and temperature swings strip the leaves.
plants.colour: Glossy mid-green leaves with a long twisted tip

plants.name: Ficus benjamina 'Barok'
plants.tip: The curled leaves hide pests. Check the undersides for scale and spider mite monthly.
plants.colour: Small mid-green leaves that curl tightly into rings

plants.name: Ficus lyrata 'Bambino'
plants.tip: Water thoroughly, then wait until the top few centimetres dry. Brown blotches are root rot.
plants.colour: Smaller, rounder deep green fiddle-shaped leaves

plants.name: Ficus lyrata 'Compacta'
plants.tip: Bright light and steady warmth. A cold windowpane in winter marks the leaves brown.
plants.colour: Deep green fiddle-shaped leaves packed on short internodes

plants.name: Ficus lyrata 'Variegata'
plants.tip: The white margins burn in direct sun and fade in shade. Bright indirect light only.
plants.colour: Deep green leaves with wide creamy-white margins

plants.name: Ficus microcarpa 'Moclame'
plants.tip: The thick leaves hold water. Let the compost dry well down before watering again.
plants.colour: Thick, rounded, dark green leaves

plants.name: Ficus microcarpa 'Green Island'
plants.tip: Takes hard pruning. Cut it back in spring and it breaks freely from old wood.
plants.colour: Small, round, very thick glossy green leaves

plants.name: Ficus microcarpa 'Tiger Bark'
plants.tip: In a shallow bonsai pot it dries within a day in summer. Water before the leaves flag.
plants.colour: Small glossy leaves over pale, mottled grey bark

plants.name: Creeping fig (Ficus pumila)
plants.tip: It never fully recovers from drying out. Keep the compost lightly moist all year.
plants.colour: Small, heart-shaped matt green leaves on wiry stems

plants.name: Ficus pumila 'Variegata'
plants.tip: The cream parts burn easily. Bright indirect light and steady moisture suit it best.
plants.colour: Small green leaves edged and splashed with cream

plants.name: Ficus pumila 'Quercifolia'
plants.tip: Tiny leaves in a small pot dry out fast. It does best in a terrarium or a humid spot.
plants.colour: Tiny lobed leaves shaped like an oak's, deep green

plants.name: Ficus pumila 'White Sunny'
plants.tip: Trim it hard once it goes leggy; it breaks freely from the cut stems.
plants.colour: Small green leaves with clean white margins

plants.name: Ficus sagittata 'Variegata'
plants.tip: Indoors it does better trailing than climbing. Keep it out of direct sun.
plants.colour: Pointed green leaves with broad cream margins

plants.name: Ficus benghalensis 'Audrey'
plants.tip: More forgiving than a fiddle leaf, but it still will not tolerate sitting wet.
plants.colour: Matt sage-green leaves with pale, clearly raised veins

plants.name: Ficus altissima 'Yellow Gem'
plants.tip: Bright light keeps the yellow margins. It sulks and drops leaves if moved about.
plants.colour: Broad leaves marbled green with yellow-green margins

plants.name: Ficus umbellata
plants.tip: The thin leaves wilt quickly. Water before the pot goes fully dry, not after.
plants.colour: Large, thin, heart-shaped bright green leaves

plants.name: Ficus cyathistipula
plants.tip: One of the easier figs indoors: it takes medium light without shedding leaves.
plants.colour: Narrow leathery dark green leaves; small green figs indoors

plants.name: Ficus aspera 'Parcellii'
plants.tip: Wants humid air. A dry room gives brown leaf edges and brings on red spider mite.
plants.colour: Green leaves marbled cream and white; cream figs striped red

plants.name: Ficus binnendijkii 'Alii'
plants.tip: Far less prone to leaf drop than a weeping fig, but still keep it out of draughts.
plants.colour: Long, narrow, drooping dark green leaves

plants.name: Ficus binnendijkii 'Amstel Gold'
plants.tip: Give it the brightest spot you have; the cream fades to green in medium light.
plants.colour: Long narrow leaves marbled cream and pale green

plants.name: Ficus religiosa
plants.tip: It is deciduous when cool, so leaf drop over winter is normal rather than a fault.
plants.colour: Heart-shaped leaves with long drip tips, bronze when new

plants.name: Ficus triangularis
plants.tip: Drops leaves if it dries out completely. Small pot, so check it regularly.
plants.colour: Small, stiff triangular leaves in matt deep green

plants.name: Ficus triangularis 'Variegata'
plants.tip: Bright indirect light holds the cream. Cut out any all-green stems as they appear.
plants.colour: Triangular leaves with wide cream margins

plants.name: Ficus deltoidea
plants.tip: It fruits young indoors. Keep it evenly moist; it sheds leaves when it dries out.
plants.colour: Rounded leathery leaves, brown-spotted beneath, with small yellow figs

plants.name: Ficus carica 'Brown Turkey'
plants.tip: Restrict the roots in a pot or a bed, or you get a large plant and very little fruit.
plants.colour: Brown-purple fruit with pale amber flesh; large lobed leaves

plants.name: Ficus carica 'Brunswick'
plants.tip: In autumn rub off every fig larger than a pea; only the pea-sized embryos overwinter.
plants.colour: Large green-bronze fruit and deeply cut leaves

plants.name: Ficus carica 'Violette de Bordeaux'
plants.tip: Ripens early enough for a British summer, but it wants the sunniest wall you have.
plants.colour: Small near-black fruit with deep red flesh
